description: Source code for rendering graphical elements during gameplay in the Unvanquished game, including HUD elements, beacons, damage indicators, and scene overlays.

methods.name: CG_ClampToRectangleAlongLine
methods.description: Clamps a point to the edge or inside of a rectangle along a line from a center point, optionally allowing interior points.

methods.name: CG_DrawField
methods.description: Draws large numerical values (e.g., status indicators) on the HUD.

methods.name: CG_MousePosEvent
methods.description: Updates cursor position and processes mouse movement if UI mouse catcher is active.

methods.name: CG_KeyEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard key events, toggling menu on ESC.

methods.name: CG_CenterPrint
methods.description: Displays important messages centered on the screen for a duration.

methods.name: CG_DrawBeacon
methods.description: Draws beacons on the HUD with icons, timers, and directional arrows.

methods.name: CG_Draw2D
methods.description: Draws 2D HUD elements, beacons, scope overlays, and damage indicators.

methods.name: CG_ScalePainBlendTCs
methods.description: Scales texture coordinates for pain overlay effects.

methods.name: CG_PainBlend
methods.description: Draws blood/health damage overlay effects on the screen.

methods.name: CG_DrawBinaryShadersFinalPhases
methods.description: Draws final phases of binary shader overlays.

methods.name: CG_DrawActive
methods.description: Performs all rendering for the current frame, including 3D scene and HUD overlays.
